paper.title_en: A "Neutrino Fog" For Gravitational Waves: The Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background from Supernova Neutrino Memory
paper.abstract_en: Gravitational waves originating from unresolved sources, or stochastic gravitational wave backgrounds (SGWBs), carry precious information about the physics underlying their diverse sources, and represent an important target for future experimental searches. Here, we model the SGWB due to core collapse supernovae. Using an extensive collection of state-of-the-art, three-dimensional, multi-second supernova simulations, we characterize the two main components of this background: one at $f \sim 10^{-2} - 1$ Hz, due to anisotropic neutrino emission (the gravitational wave memory); the other at $f \gtrsim 10^{2}$ Hz, from the near-core matter dynamics. We find that the memory component offers the best prospects of detection, as its characteristic peak at $f\sim 0.1$ Hz is within the reach of future space-born detectors. At the peak, the energy density might be comparable to that of backgrounds from slow roll inflation and from possible cosmological relics, thus potentially impacting searches of these important signals.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文直接建模了来自超新星中微子记忆的随机引力波背景，为脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）相关研究提供了关键理论贡献。
decision.title_zh: 引力波的“中微子雾”：来自超新星中微子记忆的随机引力波背景
decision.abstract_zh: 来自未分辨源的引力波，即随机引力波背景（SGWBs），携带着关于其多样来源物理的宝贵信息，并且是未来实验搜索的重要目标。在这里，我们对由核心坍缩超新星产生的S GWB进行了建模。利用大量最先进的、三维的、多秒的超新星模拟，我们刻画了这个背景的两个主要组成部分：一个在$f \sim 10^{-2} - 1$ Hz，由各向异性的中微子发射（引力波记忆）引起；另一个在$f \gtrsim 10^{2}$ Hz，来自近核心物质动力学。我们发现记忆分量提供了最好的探测前景，因为其在$f\sim 0.1$ Hz的特征峰值处于未来天基探测器的可达范围内。在峰值处，能量密度可能与慢滚暴涨以及可能存在的宇宙学遗迹的背景相当，从而可能影响对这些重要信号的搜索。
